title: Allegro Product Scraper
description: Scrape Allegro product listings by URL or keyword. Provide an Allegro listing, category or offer URL, or enter a keyword.

startUrl.title: Allegro URL
startUrl.description: Listing, category or offer URL. When filled in, it takes priority over the keyword.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search phrase used when no Allegro URL is provided.

results_wanted.title: Maximum results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of offers to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of listing pages to request, starting from the page in the URL.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: No proxy is used by default. Add an Apify Proxy group or custom proxy URLs only if Allegro challenges a run.
